Fit elastic net model

Source: R/elastic.R
elastic.Rd

Development version: fits a variational Bayes elastic-net polygenic score.

Usage

elastic(
  filename,
  pheno_mat,
  h2 = 0.3,
  alpha_param = -0.25,
  p_en = 0.1,
  F_en = 0.5,
  chunk_size = 256,
  tol = 1e-06,
  max_scans = 10
)

Arguments

filename

PLINK prefix (.bed/.bim/.fam) of the genotype data

pheno_mat

Numeric matrix of phenotypes (one column per phenotype), with IIDs as rownames

h2

Assumed SNP heritability (default: 0.3)

alpha_param

Selection parameter for the dependency of SNP heritability on MAF (default: -0.25)

p_en, F_en

Elastic-net prior hyperparameters: proportion of SNPs in the large-effect component, and the fraction of heritability they explain (defaults: 0.1 and 0.5)

chunk_size

Number of SNPs read per block (default: 256)

tol

Convergence tolerance (default: 1e-6)

max_scans

Maximum number of passes through the data (default: 10)

Value

List returned by the C++ elastic-net solver
